notes: Part 2 of the NIST CFReDS Data Leakage Case answer key (dated 2018-07-23), section 6, questions listed in 'questions'. Only 'Possible Answer' rows are transcribed; values quoted under 'Considerations' are not items (they are mentioned in an item's note where they matter). 'page' is the PDF page (the '===== PAGE n =====' marker in answers.txt), not the number printed in the page footer, as in eval/reference.json. TIME ZONES. Q15, Q17, Q23, Q25, Q27, Q31: the table is marked '(Timezone is applied)', read as US Eastern local time; all dates are 2015-03-22 to 2015-03-25, inside daylight time, so utc = printed + 4 h. Q30: the 'Timestamp' column is marked '(Timezone is applied)' (utc = printed + 4 h); the 'Modified Time (UTC-05)' column is printed in UTC-05 (utc = printed + 5 h; January dates). Q18, Q19, Q20, Q24, Q29, Q32, Q34: the answer prints no time, so no utc and no local_day. CONVENTIONS. Q15: URLs split over several printed lines are joined with nothing in between; 72 URLs are matched exactly, 2 that the key prints cut off are matched with obj_contains. The Browser column is matched with aux_contains: 'Chrome' for Chrome, 'Internet Explorer' for the key's 'IE 8' and 'IE 11' (the key itself spells it out in question 13). Q23: the 48 printed rows are 24 renames; the timestamp cell spans a 'Renamed Old' and a 'Renamed New' row, and fileRenamed holds old name in obj and new name in aux, so there is one item per rename. Only file names are matched (obj_endswith old name, aux_contains new name) because the table header says 'just file names are OK'; the printed folders are in 'nist'. Q25, Q27: printed directory paths end in a backslash; the matcher drops it. ShellBag rows are folderOpened with aux_contains 'shell' (covers 'shell bag' and 'ShellBag'); '(created)' and '(last accessed)' differ only in the time. The drive letter (E:, V:) or \\server\share is kept in obj_endswith. The four JumpList / .LNK rows of Q27 are lnkTarget, as in questions 26, 28, 35. Two of those (Q27-13, Q27-14) have identical matchers because lnkTarget cannot tell a jump list from a .LNK file. Q29: files and folders named as traces are fileCreated (the file exists) or fileDeleted (marked '(deleted)'); the key's '\User\...' spelling is not corrected, only trailing path parts are matched. Q34: one item per listed file, fileCreated in the burn folder, no time printed. No 'exhibit' matcher is set anywhere: every row here is found on the PC image, including the Q25 rows about folders on RM#2. Inconsistencies copied as printed and flagged with 'note': Q19 (Office vs Outlook folder), Q29 (\User vs \Users, missing \Local), Q30 (the two modified times are swapped relative to the log excerpt).
